generation.reproducibility_note: Actual full prompts and reference hashes recorded; model and seed unavailable. No separate API key or CLI fallback used.
sequence: generate all landscape masters, prioritizing chaerin ep01-ep05
generate each portrait with its landscape PNG as reference

art_direction.camera: seated laptop webcam height, frontal horizontal view
art_direction.style: original painterly anime background with soft shallow-depth-of-field treatment

palette.scene_light: sunset, daylight, neutral fluorescent or evening electric task lights depending on scene; white room deliberately brighter

character_safe_area.description: central lower region kept low-detail and free of foreground props for an upper-body Live2D overlay

style_reference.role: visually inspected style and safe-area guide; not supplied as generation image input

notes: Central lower foreground has no props; low-detail architectural lines and window sill may remain in background.
Chaerin ep05 uses faceless abstract original shelf ornaments instead of figurative character merchandise to honor no-character constraint.

visual_review.review_method: visual inspection of every generated image plus programmatic final size and format verification

outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original painterly anime background, landscape 4:3 full bleed. Empty contemporary fictional interior, seated laptop webcam eye height, straight frontal horizontal view, soft painted edges and gentle shallow depth-of-field. Navy violet shadows #0F0E17 #2A1F4A, restrained purple #7E54F6 accents plus scene lighting, never gold dominated. CRUCIAL character overlay safety: normalized x28-72%, y35-100% is empty low-detail wall/floor, absolutely no furniture or props in this central lower rectangle. Place all furnishings at the outer edges. Natural continuous room, no cutout. No people, faces, silhouettes, animals, text, letters, logos, brands, real places, watermarks, borders or collage. All packaging, screens, book covers blank or abstract. Scene: Quiet library, bookcases at outer left/right, individual reading desks at edges, neutral soft indoor light, peaceful subdued atmosphere, blank books and plain partitions. Modern everyday library.
